# `Q-5-15` — Invalid Glob Pattern in `project.render`

> A `project.render` pattern is not a valid glob and matches
> nothing.

## What this means

Every `project.render` entry is parsed as a glob pattern. This
warning fires when the parse fails, and the message carries the
parser's reason. The malformed entry contributes nothing; the
rest of the render list still applies.

## Why this happens

Two causes account for nearly every occurrence:

- **`**` that is not a whole path segment.** `**` means "zero or
  more directory levels" and must stand alone between slashes.
  `docs/**/*.qmd` is valid; `docs/a**b.qmd` is not.
- **An unclosed character class.** `[0-9]` is a class; `data/[.csv`
  is a parse error.

## How to fix

Rewrite the pattern using the supported vocabulary:

| Syntax | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `*` | any characters within one path segment |
| `?` | one character, never `/` |
| `**` | zero or more whole path segments |
| `[abc]`, `[a-z]` | character class |
| `[!abc]` | negated character class |
| `[*]` | a literal `*` |
